whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Haveli Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has a gorgeous glass-themed ambiance in Phulwarisharif, but your current Netlify site lacks a direct mobile table reservation and quick Zomato order button.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, interactive menu with Zomato links, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://havelirestaurants.netlify.app/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Haveli Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, fast Zomato order links, and your glass-cabin gallery in Phulwarisharif. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
